stem:
A ball is placed in a machine that throws the ball up in the air. The table represents some points on the graph of a function that models the ball's distance from the ground with respect to the time since the ball has been thrown.

Ball

| Time Since Thrown from Machine (seconds) | 0 | 0.25 | 0.50 | 0.75 | 1.00 | 1.25 | 1.50 | 1.75 |
|-----------------------------------------|---|------|------|------|------|------|------|------|
| Distance from Ground (meters)           | 0 | 2.76 | 4.90 | 6.43 | 7.35 | 7.66 | 7.35 | 6.43 |
instruction: What is the range for this situation?

options.label: F
options.text: All real numbers less than or equal to 7.66

options.label: G
options.text: All real numbers less than or equal to 1.25

options.label: H
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 7.66

options.label: J
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1.25
